_comment: Hand-written knowledge merged into index.json by `bucketmap index`.
Models come from runs against Discord: two requests on one bucket in a row tell a token bucket from a fixed window.
No limit or window is recorded here: they differ between applications and change over time.

webhook_messages.note: Sending with a webhook token and reading, editing or deleting its original message share one bucket, per webhook token.

member_roles.note: Adding and removing a member's role share one bucket, per guild.

PATCH /channels/{channel_id}: Changing a channel's name or topic sits behind a sub-limit of its own, a few per ten minutes, that the headers do not announce: only a 429 reveals it (discord/discord-api-docs#1900, #2190). The scenario renames once per run to stay clear of it.
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/messages/{: Client libraries count deletes of messages older than fourteen days, and of messages younger than ten seconds, apart from other deletes. Discord does not document it, and a run cannot create a fourteen day old message.
POST /guilds/{guild_id}/emojis: Emoji routes are limited per guild outside the usual conventions, and their headers may be inaccurate (Discord's documentation, Rate Limits).
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/emojis: Emoji routes are limited per guild outside the usual conventions, and their headers may be inaccurate (Discord's documentation, Rate Limits).
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/emojis/{emoji_id}: Emoji routes are limited per guild outside the usual conventions, and their headers may be inaccurate (Discord's documentation, Rate Limits).
PATCH /guilds/{guild_id}/emojis/{emoji_i: Emoji routes are limited per guild outside the usual conventions, and their headers may be inaccurate (Discord's documentation, Rate Limits).
DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/emojis/{emoji_: Emoji routes are limited per guild outside the usual conventions, and their headers may be inaccurate (Discord's documentation, Rate Limits).
POST /interactions/{interaction_id}/{int: Interaction endpoints are not bound to the bot's global limit (Discord's documentation, Global Rate Limit).
POST /webhooks/{webhook_id}/{webhook_tok: With an interaction token, this sends a followup: exempt from the global limit, like every interaction endpoint.
Callable without an Authorization header, in which case Discord applies the global limit to the IP address.
GET /users/{user_id}: No major parameter: whether every user shares one counter is what the scenario's back to back reads of two users show.
POST /guilds/{guild_id}/members-search: Answers 202 with a retry_after in its body while the guild's search index is being built.
GET /guilds/{guild_id}/messages/search: Answers 202 with a retry_after in its body while the guild's search index is being built.
GET /channels/{channel_id}/pins: Older pin route, replaced by /channels/{channel_id}/messages/pins, still answered.
PUT /channels/{channel_id}/pins/{message: Older pin route, replaced by /channels/{channel_id}/messages/pins, still answered.
DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/pins/{mess: Older pin route, replaced by /channels/{channel_id}/messages/pins, still answered.

not_exercised.DELETE /users/@me/guilds/{guild_id}: Makes the bot leave the guild.
not_exercised.DELETE /guilds/{guild_id}/integrations/{: Removes an integration, possibly the bot's own.
not_exercised.PATCH /users/@me: Changes the bot's profile, under a limit of a few changes per hour.
not_exercised.PUT /applications/{application_id}/comma: Replaces every global command of the application.
not_exercised.POST /channels/{channel_id}/send-soundbo: Needs the bot connected to a voice channel, through the gateway.
not_exercised.POST /guilds/{guild_id}/migrate-bypass-s: A one-time migration of the guild's permissions.
not_exercised.POST /guilds/{guild_id}/migrate-pin-perm: A one-time migration of the guild's permissions.
not_exercised.PATCH /channels/{channel_id}/explicit-me: Asks Discord to scan media for explicit content.
not_exercised.PATCH /messages/explicit-media: Asks Discord to scan media for explicit content.
